scope_contract: Every input required by the five CAL0-I3 reference scenarios is represented by one typed binding. PROVISIONAL values are low-confidence authoring priors, DISTRIBUTED values are bounded rehearsal distributions, SCENARIO values are reference-only assumptions, LOCKED values are mathematical conventions, and UNRESOLVED values require later evidence. None is a calibrated demographic or story-canon claim.

constraints.predicate: every definition has exactly one binding and every binding references one definition
every concrete value lies inside its typed definition domain
every rehearsal distribution has finite hard bounds and minimum <= mode <= maximum
every complete dependence matrix is symmetric positive semidefinite with unit diagonal
natural maturation, purposeful training, organic adaptation, Skill XP, class XP, reinforcement, and assimilation remain distinct ledgers
reference scenarios may not claim population prevalence, calibrated quantiles, or story-canon protagonist values

compatibility_contracts: I2 equations and provenance remain unchanged
I3 bindings are reference-only and uncalibrated
I4 may supersede provisional bindings without rewriting this set
